notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.3 - All Star Player
notes.notes:
We found an issue with the All Star Player achievement and made a hotfix.

The problem was that this [b]Achievement[/b] was checked ONLY if the player had 60 stars. (20 levels x 3 stars). But, because some of the users are also playing the bonus levels, you can achieve more than 60 stars so no data is sent to Stem.

Now, we make a check and this should be fixed.

Thanks again,

Raul from RVL Games

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.2 - Achievements should work for everybody now
notes.notes:
Thanks to our community we discovered a bug that blocked the game from sending Achievements data to STEAM.

We fixed this and now, it should work for everybody.

Thanks again,

Raul from RVL Games

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We released the last [b]major update[/b] for Ezaron Defense, [b]version 1.3[/b].

Now, the game is fully completed. All the bonus/endless levels are present and a lot of bugs and typos were fixed. 

This does not mean we will stop supporting the game. Major bugs or game-breaking issues will be addressed ASAP. Do not hesitate to write us on the forums or on Discord servers: https://discord.gg/P5xw2HK

Thank you once again for your support! We wouldn't be able to do this without you ;)

Raul from RVL Games

notes.title: Update 1.2
Exit from Early Access
notes.notes:
Dear Ezaron Defense Community,

It is with great joy that we are able to make this announcement.

Our journey started in 2017 and though there were tough times, we ultimately made it to this point and we can now say:

[b]EZARON DEFENSE HAS OFFICIALLY LAUNCHED![/b]

Thank you to everyone in our community, thank you to everyone who joined us in this journey, and finally, thank you to everyone for your amazing support!

Even if the game is fully launched now, we will continue to support it in the next months. We already plan 1 big update with 2 additional Endless levels and to fix any issues you may encounter.

Also, good news for the Linux and Mac OS community. We are planning to port the game to these OS in the very next future. More details soon!

Now, go and enjoy the game, we look forward to reading your feedback!

- Raul from RVL Games

notes.title: Exiting from Early Access on April 15
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to tell you the good news. The game is set to release the full version on April 15, this year.

This means the full 20 levels campaign will be available with an additional 2 bonus levels for the 'Infinite Play' mode. More details on that on the release.

After that, we plan to make an update to 1.1 somewhere in the near future. The update will contain additional bug fixing and the other 2 bonus levels :)

Thank you again for all your support. You are  a wonderful community!!!

Raul from RVL Games.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.9.1
Game Update 0.9
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce [i]Early Access version 0.9[/i] of [i]Ezaron Defense[/i] is here. Again, based on your feedback and on our roadmap we added new features, and also fix some bugs. A detailed list of the changes can be found down here.

This will be [u]the last[/u] Major Update before [b]the full game release[/b] (version 1.0). We encourage you to still send us your feedback. What do you like? What do you don't like? Drop us a visit on our [url=https://discord.gg/P5xw2HK]Discord[/url] or here on forums.

[i]note:[/i] [u]We advise[/u] you to start a new game to have a full experience, but you can also continue playing the game from where you are right now.

[h3]When are you going to release the full game?[/h3]
We plan to do it in February/March next year.

[h3]What major features we plan to add when the full game is released?[/h3]
- STEAM achievements;
- New game mode: 4 new levels to play with no wave limit;
- Full Wiki-Pedia (aka: Ezaronpedia);
- full story + 2 new bosses;
- and of course: all the 20 missions available;

After the full game released we will provide hotfixes when needed and maybe new updates. This will depend on your feedback.

[h3]
Changelog:[/h3]

- new levels
level 14 and 15 are now available

- new towers upgrades
unlock Magic Tower level 4 wich bring 2 new towers: Ice and Arcane

- new buildings in town
all the buildings from town can now be build

Minor changes:
- Polish and fixed some new paths in levels;
- Some other minor visual and sound issues fixed;

notes.title: Game Update 0.8
Game Update 0.7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce [i]Early Access version 0.7[/i] of [i]Ezaron Defense[/i] is here. Based on your feedback and on our roadmap we added new features, made some changes, and also fix some bugs. A detailed list of the changes can be found down here.

For this update, we did not add any new level, but we are planning to do this in 0.8. We decided to do this because we made some changes regarding the difficulty of some of the levels and we also added new types of enemies and need to collect some additional feedback from you.

[u]We advise you[/u] to start a new game to have a full experience, but you can also simply reply to the levels with your current profile.

[h3][b]Changelog:[/b][/h3]

[b]- New enemy type: Armored[/b]
Starting level 5, stronger enemies will attack the player. These have a gold aura, representing their Armor.
Both Archer and Magic towers have a special perk that can help you defeat these types of enemies.

Also, the first mini boss will now appear at the end of level 9 (end of chapter 2)

[b]- New Spells[/b]
2 new spells added to the collection. These are for your towers and now you can make them shoot faster or do more damage for a small amount of time

[b]- New Level 4 Towers[/b]
2 new tower updates are now available in-game.
Fire Archer Tower
Poison Archer Tower - also adds poison damage over time when the target is hit
Level 4 towers are using crysyals to upgrade. Crystals are earned by killing Armored creatures

[b]- New music track for the levels[/b]
Only one track for now, but more will come in the next updates ;)

[b]- New buildings[/b]
New buildings are now available in town. Make them to receive magic orb for research and update your city.

[b]- Cannon, Magic Towers and Electricity tower changes;[/b]
Cannon and Magic towers have now new cooldowns and damage to adjust game difficulty;
Electricity towers cannot shoot aerial units anymore. Only Archer and Magic towers will do this.

[b]- Poison spell updated[/b]
Poison spell now affects enemies for 10 seconds dealing 3 units of Damage Over Time.

[b]- Keyboard shortcut[/b]
Many of you asked, so here are keyboard shortcuts:
1, 2 and 3 for the spells
Z, X, C and V for the towers
WSAD remains for camera movement

[b]- Scroll speed changed to a higher value for the levels[/b]
We plan to add an option to make this changeable by the user

[b]- Spell range indicator now shows exactly where the spell will hit[/b]

[b]Minor changes:[/b]
- Dialogue window changed;
- Fixed a bug when ESC key does not close the in game pause menu;
- New Electric tower animation
- Tower range indicator is green now;
- Mana text color is white now;
- Changed some texts;
- On the map, the next level is now a little larger to easily identify it;
- Polish some paths in levels;
- Some other minor visual and sound issues fixed;

notes.title: Ezaron Defense EA release on October 22, 2020
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

First of all, thank you for all your patience and wishlists :)

[h2]We have great news!![/h2]

Finally, we decided to launch the game in [u]Early Access[/u] on [u]October 22[/u]. We are aware that you all wanted a full game but because we are a very small team (2 guys) we need your help to make a fully gold version.



With an Early Access release, players can support and keep us afloat but they also now have access to a fully playable game. Another aspect we considered is taking feedback from players which will help us improve the game and make it better.

Thank you all and we'll see on October 22!

notes.title: Ezaron Defense Open Alpha version is here
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that [b]Ezaron Defense[/b] Alpha version now available to PC gamers via Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1306100/Ezaron_Defense_Alpha/]HERE[/url]

Since this is not the final version of the game, there’s still a chance users can experience bugs and find imperfections. In order to improve the final release of the game, we encourage gamers to send their feedback about gameplay here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1306100/discussions/1/

[b]Ezaron Defense[/b] is expected to be in [i]Alpha version[/i] just for a few months. During this stage, the game will be [b]Free[/b].

Enjoy [b]Ezaron Defense[/b] and have a great and safe Summer!
